These three scripts are copied unmodified from GMGN's gmgn-skills repository
(https://github.com/GMGNAI/gmgn-skills, commit 6a04e1f), MIT licensed (see LICENSE).

- dev_score.py        <- skills/gmgn-dev-score/dev_score.py
- holder_analysis.py  <- skills/gmgn-holder-analysis/analyze.py
- wallet_analysis.py  <- skills/gmgn-wallet-analysis/analyze.py

kraken runs them as subprocesses (they call gmgn-cli themselves) and shows their output.
